Bahrain's civil defence evacuates multi-storey building due to fire

Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior said that civil defence teams evacuated a multi-storey building in the Gulf country's north west due to a fire. 

"Civil Defence evacuated a multi-story building in Souq Waqif as a precaution, and extinguished a fire in the building. No injuries were reported," the ministry said in a statement. 

"The National Ambulance took the necessary measures at the site, and investigations are underway to determine the cause of the fire," it added.

articles.title: Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran
articles.summary:
Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cast doubt about reports of an "imminent threat" from Iran on Washington.

Speaking to reporters in the Philippines, Rubio said that US authorities routinely check for  potential threats against the country, but added that most intelligence leads are not considered credible. 

When asked if he was concerned about a possible attack on Washington, he said: "I am not. But again, we're concerned every day about anything that threatens our country ... I don't think there's any imminent threat."

"The United States is always on the lookout for anyone who tries to do harm to our country and to our people. And we have threat streams every day, and the majority of them are not credible. We have to follow up on them," Rubio added.

Rubio also questioned the credibility of sources cited in a CNN report about an alleged Iranian plot targeting the US capital, saying: "Some of your intelligence sources are liars; others are liars and criminals."

"I won't even comment on it because I don't know who's leaking this stuff to you guys. But they're either showboats and liars, or probably criminals if they're saying anything that's even half true."

articles.title: Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank
articles.summary:
Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank

Israeli settlers shot dead an elderly Palestinian woman and wounded eight of her family members during an attack outside her home in the village of Ein al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho in the occupied West Bank. 

According to eyewitnesses, armed settlers shot 73-year-old Fidda Fheidat in the head, killing her on the spot. 

The settlers, who had recently seized eight Palestinian homes in an area adjacent to the village, went on to fire at other members of the family, wounding eight of them. 

According to Jihad Mahalis, a member of the village’s local committee, the settlers have launched attacks on the village homes every single night since seizing the properties, which are located some 500 metres away from the rest of the village’s homes.

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické tlaky na Izrael ohledně humanitární pomoci v Gaze a zvýšenou ostražitost amerických sil v reakci na regionální útoky dronů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic pressure on Israel regarding humanitarian aid in Gaza and heightened vigilance by US forces in response to regional drone attacks are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Regionální napětí výrazně eskaluje kvůli přímé konfrontaci mezi Íránem a americkými silami v oblasti Perského zálivu a Hormuzského průlivu, kde byly hlášeny útoky na tankery a drony. V Izraeli a Gaze mezitím přetrvává vysoké bezpečnostní riziko, které podtrhují incidenty v Západním břehu a rostoucí mezinárodní tlak na humanitární přístup. Sýrie prochází křehkou fází s návratem milionů uprchlíků, zatímco EU obnovuje spolupráci s Damaškem.
archive.security_status_en: Regional tensions are escalating significantly due to direct confrontation between Iran and US forces in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, where tanker and drone attacks have been reported. Meanwhile, Israel and Gaza face persistent security risks underscored by West Bank incidents and mounting international pressure over humanitarian access. Syria is experiencing a fragile transition with the return of millions of refugees as the EU resumes cooperation with Damascus.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci napětí kolem Hormuzského průlivu v reakci na íránské aktivity proti americkým a komerčním cílům a zostřenou diplomatickou rétoriku ohledně Gazy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of tensions around the Strait of Hormuz is expected in response to Iranian activities targeting US and commercial assets, alongside heightened diplomatic rhetoric over Gaza.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává kritická kvůli přetrvávajícím vojenským operacím v Gaze, rostoucímu napětí a kybernetickým i kinetickým incidentům v okolí Íránu a Hormuzského průlivu. Západní státy mezitím uvalují sankce na izraelské subjekty za aktivity na Západním břehu, zatímco diplomatická jednání ohledně Libanonu a regionální stability stagnují.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains critical due to ongoing military operations in Gaza, escalating tensions and kinetic/cyber incidents around Iran and the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Western nations are imposing sanctions on Israeli entities over West Bank activities, while diplomatic talks regarding Lebanon and regional stability remain deadlocked.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat pokračující bezpečnostní incidenty v oblasti Perského zálivu a diplomatické třenice mezi Izraelem a západními spojenci kvůli humanitární situaci v Gaze. Riziko širší eskalace mezi Íránem a jeho zástupci zůstává na vysoké úrovni.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued security incidents in the Gulf region and diplomatic friction between Israel and Western allies over the humanitarian situation in Gaza are expected. The risk of broader escalation involving Iran and its proxies remains elevated.

archive.security_status_cs: Region čelí stupňujícím se diplomatickým a bezpečnostním třenicím, včetně nových západních sankcí vůči izraelským představitelům a osadníkům. Íránské aktivity zahrnují přímé útoky na regionální infrastrukturu a spojence USA, zatímco Irák obnovuje ropné toky přes turecký ropovod navzdory vnitřním politickým stand-offům.
archive.security_status_en: The region faces escalating diplomatic and security friction, including new Western sanctions targeting Israeli officials and settlers. Iranian activities involve direct attacks on regional infrastructure and US allies, while Iraq resumes oil flows via the Turkish pipeline despite internal political standoffs.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně sankcí vůči Izraeli a zvýšenou ostražitost vůči íránským aktivitám v Perském zálivu. Humanitární a bezpečnostní situace v Gaze a na Západním břehu zůstane nestabilní.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers regarding sanctions against Israel and heightened vigilance against Iranian activities in the Gulf are expected. The humanitarian and security situation in Gaza and the West Bank will remain unstable.
